answer_1.quote: We conducted comprehensive experiments on three conditional generation tasks: story generation on ROCStories, headline generation on MIND and PENS, and paraphrase generation on ParaSCI. For unconditional generation, we utilized the popular Yelp dataset.

answer_2.quote: For the conditional generation tasks, we evaluate the quality of the generated text by BLEU, ROUGE, BertScore, and CND. For diversity, we assess Dist, JS, and Self-BLEU.

answer_4.quote: We also conduct a human evaluation of the fluency of generated texts on ROCStories. See Appendix A.5 for the concrete evaluation protocol. We recruited four annotators with adequate English skills and asked them to score the fluency of the shuffled stories on a scale of 1-5.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators scored fluency on a 1-5 scale for generated stories.
